verdict.rationale: SumUp runs a first-party managed MCP server. Its docs say users can 'use your AI assistant to... query your merchant account', create checkouts, and process payments, so the account can be operated through natural-language prompts. That operation only happens through a third-party MCP-compatible AI client; the evidence shows no native natural-language interface in SumUp's own app or dashboard. missing for 10: built-in natural-language command interface within SumUp's own products, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation, documented breadth of operations beyond checkouts, transactions and profile queries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use your AI assistant to build SumUp payment integrations, troubleshoot checkout flows, or query your merchant account.
This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments using Cloud API.
Query your merchant profile and review transactions.
Create checkouts and inspect their status.
